# EatPal

> EatPal helps parents of picky eaters and kids with ARFID plan meals around the foods a child already accepts, then widen that list one small step at a time.

## Docs

- [Food chaining](https://tryeatpal.com/features/food-chaining): how the app suggests the next food to try
- [Grocery lists](https://tryeatpal.com/features/grocery-lists): one list built from the week's plan

Contact: https://tryeatpal.com/about
